children: Overview
South Africa precious metals miner's H1 revenue rose 64% yr/yr to record R90 bln
Adjusted EBITDA more than doubled, net profit swung from loss to R18.8 bln
Company declared interim dividend of R5.7 bln, supported by strong cash generation
Outlook
Burnstone project expected to produce about 130,000oz gold annually at steady state
Mt Lyell project targeted to produce 26kt copper, 16koz gold and 116koz silver annually at steady state
Company aims to reduce US PGM all-in sustaining cost to about $1,000/2Eoz by end-2028
Result Drivers
STRONGER COMMODITY PRICES - Co said significantly higher platinum group metals and gold prices contributed to record revenue and earnings
DISCIPLINED COST MANAGEMENT - Co attributed improved margins and earnings to cost controls and operational efficiency in SA operations
RECYCLING BUSINESS SCALE-UP - Increased scale and successful integration of new recycling facilities drove higher volumes, margin expansion and strong cash generation
